# Cross that bridge when we come to it.

Welcome to my website! My name is Connie Dong, and I am currently a senior majoring in Nutritional Biochemistry and Metabolism at Case Western Reserve University, with minors in Chemistry, Biology, and Japanese. I am particularly interested in understanding the biological mechanisms underlying nutrition, health, and disease and how scientific research can inform evidence-based healthcare practices.

This past summer, I participated in undergraduate research at Cleveland Clinic's Erzurum Lab, where I assisted with laboratory procedures, data analysis, and research communication. My research experience includes exploring the association between mitochondrial DNA and asthma risk. Beyond the laboratory, I have also gained exposure to clinical nutrition and healthcare operations through internships and dietitian shadowing at Shanghai United Family Hospital.

Through this website, I hope to share my academic journey of developing analytical skills, exploring scientific investigations, and learning how scientific evidence can be translated into meaningful insights.

Please feel free to [contact me](mailto:cxd460@case.edu).
